Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated IMDb’s incorrect/irrelevant plot blurb (“Bang-ja” and “Chun-hyang,” which belongs to The Servant, 2010) with Forbidden Quest (2006), Kim Dae-woo’s directorial debut. Instead of recognizing this mismatch and resolving the discrepancy using authoritative sources (e.g., KOFIC/HanCinema indicating the scholar Kim Yoon-seo and the king’s favorite concubine Jeong-bin), the Planner treated the conflict as minor variation. This failure to distinguish between two different films led to an incorrect understanding of who the debut film was about.
